errors.evidence: The list of categories on the vertical axis does not end with 'Производство и разпределение...'. The final item is 'Общо (Всички икономически дейности...)'.

The description states the units are 'хиляди лева' (thousand BGN), but the full unit specified in the chart is 'хил.лв./заето лице' (thousand BGN/employed person). The 'per employed person' part is omitted.
The value for the category 'Други дейности' is stated as 2.979, but the chart shows it is 22.979.
